title: Cuisine TMA — Search Decision Tree
subtitle: How every search mode composes, and which one wins when they collide.
generatedNote: Single source of truth. The hosted mind-map (search-strategy.html), the canonical doc (search-strategy.md), and the combination test matrix (__tests__/search-mode-matrix.test.js) all read THIS file. Edit here, regenerate, re-test.

dimensions.label: Michelin / Bib Gourmand
dimensions.gates: Everything: rating, New, quick-filters, special-mode are all ignored.
dimensions.behavior: Returns a curated, pre-vetted list (stars + Bib tiers shuffled). Other cuisine chips only RE-RANK; they are not hard filters.

dimensions.label: Fruits (special-mode)
dimensions.behavior: Fruit stalls / juice. Rating floor from ratingPref STILL applies (unlike durian).

dimensions.label: Durian (special-mode)
dimensions.gates: rating floor (SKIPPED — soft 3.7), halal (auto-off), homeBased (skipped), New (skipped).
dimensions.behavior: Soft 3.7 — keep ALL stalls (incl. <3.7 and unrated); ≥3.7/unrated ordered first; TMA shows the soft-rating notice.

dimensions.label: Durian Pastry (special-mode)
dimensions.gates: rating floor (SKIPPED — soft 3.7), halal (auto-off), homeBased, New.
dimensions.behavior: Durian puffs / cakes / mochi. Same soft-rating as durian. Requires a pastry signal in name.

dimensions.label: New (newly-opened pill)
dimensions.gates: Relaxes a numeric rating floor down to 3.0.
dimensions.behavior: Keeps venues ≤183 days old; rated venues must be >3.0 OR unrated; strict (≤109d) pages ahead of fill (110-183d).

dimensions.label: Rating preference
dimensions.behavior: any → keep all; no-rating → keep unrated/low-review; numeric → floor (never empties the pool — demotes, not drops).

dimensions.label: Quick filters (combo)
dimensions.input: filters.{halal, openNow, vegetarian, homeBased, petFriendly, prices}
dimensions.gatedBy: Michelin (all ignored); special-mode (halal auto-off, homeBased skipped; others apply).
dimensions.behavior: Stack on a base/special-mode search. Under Michelin they are ignored entirely.

precedence.rule: If 'michelin' is selected, return the curated list and IGNORE special-mode, New, rating, and quick-filters.
Else if specialMode is set (and passes the belt gate for durian): seeds override cuisines; durian/durian-pastry skip the rating floor (soft 3.7); halal auto-off; homeBased + New are skipped.
Else (cuisine / free-text): ratingPref floor AND the New pill both apply; New relaxes a numeric floor to 3.0; quick-filters apply.

conflicts.note: Michelin early-returns before the special-mode branch is reached.
Curated list has no recency filter.
Rating pill is UI-disabled under Michelin; no floor applied.
Filters ignored; cuisine chips only re-rank.
Soft 3.7 — durian skips the floor entirely.
New recency block does not run in special-mode.
Halal is auto-cleared in special-mode (most stalls uncertified; avoids an empty list).
homeBased modifier is skipped when specialMode is set.
New relaxes the floor to 3.0 so newly-opened 3.0–3.7 venues show.
Fruits (unlike durian) keeps the ratingPref floor.

tree: 1. Resolve location & context (lat/lng, region, country, radius, ratingPref).
2. Michelin selected? → curated list, ignore all else. [END]
3. specialMode set? → belt gate (durian/pastry); seeds override; halal auto-off; homeBased + New skipped.
4. Run Places discover (+ widen, + zero-result generic fallback) — all budget-guarded.
6. New pill (base only): recency ≤183d + rating >3.0/unrated; stamp strict/fill band.
7. Rating floor: skipped for durian/pastry (soft 3.7); else applyRatingFloor(ratingPref); New relaxes numeric → 3.0; never empties.
8. Sort: durian ≥3.7 first → recency band → distance. Slice (first tap 6, then 12).
9. Overall 20s deadline guards the whole route — degraded-200 before any gateway 502.
